info.name: Recipe Enhancement — Local Demo
info.description: Offline requests use no OpenAI credits. LIVE requests are metered. No API key belongs in Postman; configure it in the server .env. Domain rejections return HTTP 200 with result.status=failed; inspect the JSON.

exec: pm.test("Applied real change", () => { const r = pm.response.json().result; pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("applied"); pm.expect(r.changes[0].to_text).to.eql("0.5 cup white sugar"); });
pm.test("No false success", () => { const r = pm.response.json().result; pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("failed"); pm.expect(r.reason).to.eql("target_not_found"); pm.expect(r.changes).to.eql([]); });
